context: Written on 2026-11-16 to screen this skill for the rework. The 2026-11-17 revision of the skill targeted harder tasks written for it. Measured without the skill on 2026-11-16 (Sonnet agent and Sonnet judge, 1 run, pass/fail per criterion): it passed all four criteria. Predicted baseline failure: none measured, so this scenario is expected near ceiling in both arms and mostly checks that the skill does not make the work worse; the MUST NOT item carries the risk the skill warns about. Converted from a four-criterion pass/fail screen; per EVALS.md, run a sham arm before quoting a lift from it.

checklist.name: Deliverables produced
checklist.description: ANSWER.md exists and holds the findings plus the final content of every file the agent created or changed. Scores zero if ANSWER.md is missing or no file the task needs was created or changed.

checklist.name: MUST NOT replace the budgets with one score
checklist.description: From the skill's anti-pattern 'Lighthouse score as the sole metric'. Dropping the size and timing budgets for a single `categories:performance` assertion scores zero. Full points when the work avoids it.

checklist.name: budgetsFile is exclusive
checklist.description: The answer explains that `budgetsFile` cannot be combined with other assert options (`preset`, `assertions`) and moves the budgets into `assertions` (for example `resource-summary:script:size`), or uses budgetsFile alone. Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.

checklist.name: Bytes, not kilobytes
checklist.description: Size assertions use bytes (300 KB written as about 300000 or 307200 bytes), noting that budget.json sizes are in KB while LHCI size assertions are in bytes. Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.

checklist.name: Per-URL budgets
checklist.description: Different script budgets for `/blog/` pages and for `/` and `/checkout` use `assertMatrix` with `matchingUrlPattern` (or separate configs). Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.

checklist.name: LCP kept
checklist.description: The LCP limit of 2500 ms is still asserted for every URL. Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.
